Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and the State.

2. This is an application for bail U/s.438 Cr.P.C. filed by the Petitioner in anticipation of arrest for his alleged involvement in the offences U/s.417/376(2)(n)/342/294/323/506 of IPC R/w. Sections.
3(1)(r)/ 3(1)(s)/3(2)(va) of SC & ST (POA) Act.
3. In view of the bar under Sections 18 and 18-A of the SC & ST (PA) Act, the present application under Section 438, Cr.P.C. is not maintainable.

In view of the dictum issued by the Apex Court in the matter of Prithvi Raj Chauhan v. Union of India and Others, reported in (2020) 1 OLR SC 419 this Court examined the case in hand but found prima facie material in the offences under the Special statute.

(iii) The learned Court is further directed to consider the case of the Petitioner in accordance with law and shall dispose of the application on the very same day itself,
